_readme: Promotions shown on the site. A promo displays only when active=true AND verified=true AND today is between start and end (America/Denver). Expired promos disappear automatically on the next page load (client-side) and on the next build (server-side). Never set verified=true for an offer the POS cannot honor. No coupon codes are shown unless 'code' is filled AND codeVerifiedInToast=true.

promotions.title: October $9.99 Deal
promotions.description: Any regular Customer Favorite burrito plus a 20 oz soda for $9.99. Favorites with guac or queso are charged extra.
promotions.terms: As listed on each location's online menu on Oct 26, 2026. DU includes a 20 oz bottled soda. End date assumed from the offer name; confirm with ownership.

promotions.title: $5 off $30+
promotions.description: Save $5 on online orders of $30 or more. Apply the offer at checkout.
promotions.terms: Shown in the Rewards & Savings panel on the online ordering page for these locations on Oct 26, 2026. Terms set at checkout.

promotions.title: $5 off your first online order of $25+
promotions.description: New to ordering online? First-time guests get $5 off an order of $25 or more.
promotions.terms: First-time guests only. Shown in online ordering for these locations on Oct 26, 2026.

promotions.title: Burrito Bucks: 25 points just for joining
promotions.description: Earn 1 point for every $1 spent and unlock $10 off every 100 points.
promotions.terms: loyalty program. DU (ghost kitchen) rewards sign-up was inactive on Oct 26, 2026.

promotions.title: Taco Tuesday at Park Hill
promotions.description: Single street tacos from $2.50 (chicken) and $3.00 (steak or carnitas), plus $2 chips and salsa.
promotions.terms: Taco Tuesday items listed on the Park Hill online menu on Oct 26, 2026. Confirm days and hours with the store.

promotions.title: Happy Hour in Arvada, 2–5 pm
promotions.description: Daily drink and snack specials on the Arvada patio. Game-day specials have included $5 margaritas, $2 chicken street tacos and $4 Coronas.
promotions.terms: Happy hour times and specials from the current Arvada happy hour page; confirm current pricing with the store before promoting.

promotions.title: 20% off your first order
promotions.description: Claim found on the current /benefits-of-ordering-direct page. Not found online.
promotions.terms: Do not publish unless ownership confirms the POS can honor it.
